name: scan_font_directory_entries
description: As library code, this routine allocates a table, then walks a directory with examine and next-entry calls. It copies each qualifying entry's name and two attribute bytes into a fixed-size record and stores the record count in the table header, then unlocks the directory.

name: free_block_with_size_header
description: Library code that frees a memory block, taking the size from the longword just before the pointer it receives and passing the block start and that size to the free-memory call.

name: forbid_multitasking
description: Library stub that calls the exec library's Forbid routine to disable task switching, then returns.

name: permit_multitasking
description: Library stub that calls the exec library's Permit routine to re-enable task switching, then returns.

name: allocate_memory_stub
description: Library stub that loads its arguments and calls the exec library's AllocMem routine, returning the address of the block it allocates.

name: copy_null_terminated_string
description: Copies bytes from a source string to a destination one at a time, including the terminating zero byte, until the zero byte has been copied.

name: append_null_terminated_string
description: Advances to the zero byte that ends the destination string, then passes that position and the source argument to another routine, so the source text is appended after the existing text.

name: skip_string_end_and_call
description: Advances the address register past a zero-terminated string and passes the position of the terminating zero byte to another routine. It performs no other work.

name: measure_null_terminated_string_length
description: Counts the bytes before the zero terminator of a string and returns that count.

name: count_bytes_to_null_terminator
description: Adds one to a count held in a register for each byte read from a zero-terminated string, including the terminating zero byte, and returns the total.

name: compare_null_terminated_strings
description: Compares two zero-terminated strings byte by byte, returning zero if they are identical, minus one if the first differing byte of the first string is smaller, and one otherwise.

name: compare_string_prefix_in_registers
description: Compares a zero-terminated string with the start of another string, both held in address registers. It returns zero when the first string ends with every byte matching, and minus one or one at the first difference.

name: compare_strings_in_registers
description: Compares two zero-terminated strings held in address registers byte by byte, returning zero if they are identical, minus one if the first differing byte is smaller in the first string, and one otherwise.

name: find_char_in_string
description: Scans a zero-terminated string for a given byte and returns its address, or zero if the terminating zero byte is reached first.

name: find_char_from_current_position
description: Starts from a byte already loaded in a register and walks forward through a zero-terminated string, returning the address of the first byte matching the search byte, or zero if the string ends first.

name: find_char_after_current_position
description: Advances past the current position in a zero-terminated string and returns the address of the next byte matching the search byte, or zero if the terminating zero byte is reached first.

name: find_last_char_in_string
description: Measures a zero-terminated string, then scans it backward from the end for a given byte, returning the address of the last match or zero if there is none.

name: find_char_backward_to_limit
description: Scans backward one byte at a time from the current address for a given byte, stopping at a lower limit held in a register. It returns the address of the match, or zero if none is found above the limit.

name: find_char_backward_after_step
description: Steps back one byte before each comparison while scanning toward a lower limit held in a register for a given byte. It returns the address of the match, or zero once the limit is passed.

name: find_path_name_start
description: Locates the last slash or colon in a path string and returns the address just after it, where the file name begins. If the path has neither, it returns the original address.

name: increment_register_value
description: Returns the value held in a data register increased by one, with no other effect.

name: forward_to_library_handler
description: Library code that calls another routine and returns without doing other work, so it acts as a forwarding entry point for the library.

name: forward_to_external_handler
description: Calls another routine through a function pointer and returns, with no other work. It is a forwarding stub for the library.

name: forbid_task_switching_entry
description: Library entry that calls the exec library's Forbid stub and then returns, disabling task switching for the caller.

name: forward_to_secondary_handler
description: Calls one more routine and returns, adding no other work. It forwards the library entry to a second handler.

name: initialize_hardware_and_copper_list
description: Program entry code that clears a block of memory, sets a disk-control port bit, writes the copper display list into memory, and programs the audio, DMA and interrupt control registers before the rest of the program runs.

name: handle_keyboard_interrupt
description: Interrupt code for the keyboard serial port that acknowledges the CIA interrupt request by clearing the port interrupt flag. When a debug-style flag bit is set, it enters an endless loop instead.

name: render_text_string_to_bitplanes
description: Walks a zero-terminated string and, for each printable character, copies its eight glyph bytes into eight rows of a 40-byte-wide buffer, advancing one column per character. A control byte moves output to the next text row, and at the end a scaled value derived from the following byte is stored in a field.

name: init_bitmap_descriptor
description: Stores a data address and three fixed 16-bit values into a four-field descriptor passed in an address register, to set up a graphics buffer.

name: update_fade_and_clear_buffer
description: When its timing counters allow, advances a grey palette fade one step and writes the grey entries into the copper color list. It then flips between two display buffers and clears the new back buffer with the blitter.

name: advance_scroll_frame_with_timer
description: Counts down a timer, flips between two display buffers, and when a position value passes a threshold moves six stored positions back by a fixed step and redraws columns. It then adds to a block of positions and clears the back buffer with the blitter.

name: advance_scroll_frame
description: Flips between two display buffers, and when a position value passes a threshold moves six stored positions back by a fixed step and redraws columns. It then adds to a block of positions, updates the display list and clears the back buffer with the blitter.

name: draw_circle_outline_xor
description: Plots a circle outline by XOR-toggling pixel bits in a 40-byte-wide bitmap, computing each distance from the radius and step values. It writes into one of two destination buffers chosen by a flag, over sixty-five steps.

name: xor_plot_circle_from_table
description: Plots one half of a circle by XOR-toggling pixel bits, reading each distance from a precomputed table. It writes into one of two bitmaps chosen by a flag and stops after sixty-five steps.

name: xor_plot_circle_mirrored_pixels
description: Plots circle pixels by XOR-toggling bits at the current position and its mirrored position in the bitmap, stepping through a table of distances until the step count reaches sixty-five.

name: open_helper_library_and_return
description: Entry code for the iff library that opens a second library through the exec library, calls two of its routines, closes it and returns the value five. The version text in the file is not used by this routine.

name: initialize_empty_list_header
description: Stores its argument in a structure, records the result of a library call in another field, and sets up an empty list header inside the structure.

name: allocate_and_queue_task_record
description: When a condition holds, looks up the current task, allocates a memory block, stores the task pointer in it and adds it to a list. It then increments a counter and clears a flag bit in the structure.

name: remove_node_and_decrement_count
description: Removes an item from its list and frees its memory when a condition holds, then decrements a counter. When the counter reaches zero and a flag bit is set, it calls a routine to finish the release.

name: remove_close_library_when_idle
description: When its counter is zero, removes an item from its list, closes a library, frees the memory and returns a stored value. Otherwise it sets a pending flag bit and returns zero.

name: remove_close_and_free_record
description: Removes an item from its list, closes a library and frees its memory, then returns a value read from the record.

name: read_iff_form_record
description: Opens a file, reads a chunk header, and when the chunk type is FORM allocates a record and fills it with the size and position read from the file. It returns the record, or zero when a check fails.

name: read_iff_form_record_alternate
description: Opens a file, reads a chunk header, and when the chunk type is FORM allocates a record and fills it with the size and position read from the file. It returns the record, or zero when a check fails.

name: create_form_record_from_args
description: Checks that a chunk type is FORM, allocates a record for it, and stores the given size and two values in the record. It returns the record, or zero with an error code recorded when a check fails.

name: allocate_iff_chunk_record
description: Allocates a memory block, stores a size and chunk type in it along with two further values, and returns the block, or zero when allocation fails.

name: read_chunk_header_record
description: Stores a value in the first field of a record, reads data from the file into the record, and records two more values in later fields. It returns the record, or zero on a read error.

name: store_fields_and_close_file
description: Stores three values into a record, then closes the file through the dos library and returns.

name: forward_to_iff_helper
description: Calls one routine and returns, adding no other work. It forwards the library entry to a helper.

name: free_block_if_present
description: Frees a memory block when one is passed in, using the exec library's free-memory routine, then calls another routine and returns.

name: find_chunk_record_by_id
description: Walks a list of records stored in a block, comparing each record's first field with a given value, and returns the first matching record or zero when it reaches the end.

name: add_eight_to_routine_result
description: Calls another routine and returns its result plus eight.

name: pack_byte_groups_into_words
description: Combines each group of three source bytes into one 16-bit word using shifts and ORs, writes the words to the destination in order and returns the number of groups.

name: load_ilbm_bitmap_chunks
description: Checks that a chunk is an ILBM form, then copies the bitmap header fields. It compares the plane count with the caller's request, looks up the color map, and chooses a decoding routine from the compression flag.

name: copy_byte_block
description: Copies a block of bytes from a source address to a destination address, using a count held in a register.

name: unpack_packbits_run_data
description: Decompresses run-length data: a negative count repeats the following byte that many times, and a non-negative count copies that many literal bytes, until the output count is used up.

name: forward_to_iff_decoder
description: Calls another routine and returns without other work, forwarding the caller's request to it.

name: write_ilbm_file_with_header
description: Writes an IFF ILBM file header, then for each image word expands it into three bytes and writes them to the file, closing the file when done.

name: finish_iff_chunk_and_close
description: Pads the written chunk to a four-byte boundary when needed, seeks back to the chunk size field, writes the final size and closes the file.

name: close_file_if_open
description: Closes the file through the dos library when a flag is set, then calls another routine and returns.

name: write_bitplane_rows_with_offsets
description: Computes row offsets for each bitplane from the image width and depth, then writes each plane's rows to the file one at a time, adding the offset of each row. It returns the total size or a write error code.

name: write_compressed_plane_rows
description: Computes row offsets for each bitplane, encodes each row with the run-length routine, adds the encoded size to a running total and writes the encoded row to the file. It returns the total size or a write error code.

name: pack_bytes_run_length_encode
description: Compresses a block with the PackBits run-length method: a run of at least three equal bytes becomes a negative count and the byte, and other bytes become literal runs with a positive count. It returns the number of output bytes.

name: pack_bytes_run_length_alternate
description: Second entry of the same run-length encoder. From the current position it writes repeat or literal runs with their counts and returns the number of output bytes.

name: write_packbits_literal_run
description: Part of the run-length encoder that writes a block of literal bytes with a positive count, then checks for the next repeated run, and returns the output size so far.

name: count_repeated_bytes_to_limit
description: Counts how many following bytes repeat the first byte, stopping at the end of the data or after 128 bytes, and leaves the count in a register.

name: find_current_task_record
description: Looks up the current task, then walks a list of records and returns the first record whose task field matches it, or zero if none does.

name: clear_record_field_when_flagged
description: Calls another routine, then clears a field in the record when a condition does not hold, and returns one.

name: store_nonzero_value_in_record
description: Calls another routine, then stores the register value in a record field when that value is non-zero, and returns zero.

name: take_record_value_or_fail
description: Calls another routine. When it reports success, returns the value stored in a record field and clears that field, otherwise returns minus one.

name: return_minus_one_failure
description: Returns minus one to the caller, signalling failure, with no other work.

name: compute_bitmap_mode_flags
description: Returns a mode flags word taken from a header, with an extra flag bit set when the stored depth is greater than five and a second condition holds.

name: add_depth_mode_flag
description: Calls routines to obtain a mode flags word and sets an extra flag bit when the stored depth is greater than five, then returns the word.

name: compute_display_mode_flags
description: Derives display flags from the width, depth and a second dimension in a header. It sets one flag for wide, low-depth images and another when the second dimension exceeds 279.

name: open_helper_library_and_return
description: Entry code for the iff library that opens a second library through the exec library, calls two of its routines, closes it and returns the value five. The version text in the file is not used by this routine.

name: return_stack_argument
description: Returns the first argument pushed on the stack, unchanged.

name: accumulate_bitmap_rows
description: Decodes the rows of image data through a decompression routine and adds the first word of each source row to every word of the destination row, repeating over the image rows.

name: accumulate_bitmap_rows_with_header
description: Copies header fields from the source record, then decodes each image row through a decompression routine and adds the first word of the row to every word of the destination, until the data end is reached.

name: accumulate_bitmap_rows_from_entry
description: Enters the row decoding loop partway through, decoding each image row through a decompression routine and adding the first word of the row to every destination word until the rows are finished.

name: accumulate_bitmap_rows_by_mode
description: Checks a mode byte. When the mode is zero or one it decodes image rows through the matching decompression routine, adding the first word of each row to every destination word. Otherwise it calls another routine and returns.

name: accumulate_bitmap_rows_if_flag
description: When a flag byte equals one, decodes image rows and adds the first word of each row to every destination word. Otherwise it calls another routine and returns.

name: accumulate_bitmap_rows_to_limit
description: Decodes image rows through a decompression routine, adding the first word of each row to every destination word, until the position reaches a limit held in a register.

name: forward_to_decode_entry
description: Calls another routine and returns without other work, forwarding the caller's request to it.

description: Decompresses PackBits-style run-length data in a second form: a control byte with the high bit set repeats the next byte for the given run, and a control byte without it copies the following literal bytes, until the output count is used up.

name: add_depth_mode_flag
description: Calls routines to obtain a mode flags word and sets an extra flag bit when the stored depth is greater than five, then returns the word.

name: compute_display_mode_flags
description: Derives display flags from the width, depth and a second dimension in a header. It sets one flag for wide, low-depth images and another when the second dimension exceeds 279.

name: store_argument_and_register_object
description: Calls a library routine to obtain a value. When that value is non-zero it stores the argument at offset 34 of the object and calls a second library routine on it, and returns whether the value was non-zero.

name: store_argument_and_register_object
description: Library code that obtains a value from one library routine. If it is non-zero, it stores the argument at offset thirty-four in that object and calls a second routine, returning whether the value was non-zero.

name: open_dos_and_graphics_libraries
description: Opens two libraries and, when both open, creates a structure with an empty list header and returns it. If either open fails, it releases what it has and returns zero.

name: release_unused_font_entries
description: Walks a list of loaded font entries, removes each entry whose use count is not positive, then closes two libraries, frees the object and returns the stored value once no users remain.

name: close_and_free_when_unused
description: When the use count is zero, closes two libraries, removes the object from its list, frees its memory and returns a stored value. Otherwise it sets a pending-release flag and returns zero.

name: mark_object_pending_release
description: Sets the high bit of a flag byte in the object to mark it as pending release, then returns zero.

name: return_immediately
description: Returns to the caller without doing any work.

name: clear_flag_and_increment_use
description: Clears the pending-release bit in a flag byte of the object and increments its use count.

name: decrement_use_count_checking_pending
description: Decrements the object's use count. When the count is still non-zero and the pending-release flag is set, it calls a library routine and returns its result, otherwise it returns zero.

name: score_font_descriptor_match
description: Compares two font descriptors by scoring the difference in their size and the style bits set differently between them, using a table of seven weights. It returns a signed score, where a larger value means a poorer match.

name: load_named_font_file
description: Copies a font name into a local buffer, then searches the FONTS directory for a matching font file using lock, examine and read library calls. It loads the font data into allocated memory and returns it, or zero when no match is found.

name: copy_null_terminated_string
description: Copies bytes from a source string to a destination one at a time, including the terminating zero byte, until the zero byte has been copied.

name: compare_adjacent_bytes
description: Compares the byte just before one address with the byte at another address, returning minus one when the first is smaller and one otherwise.

name: find_last_char_in_string
description: Measures a zero-terminated string, then scans it backward from the end for a given byte, returning the address of the last match or zero if there is none.

name: find_path_name_start
description: Locates the last slash or colon in a path string and returns the address just after it, where the file name begins. If the path has neither, it returns the original address.

name: build_available_fonts_list
description: Walks a list of font entries and writes a header and an array of records, each holding a name and style fields, into a caller's buffer. When one flag bit is set it lists the loaded fonts, and when another is set it also scans the FONTS directory.

name: append_loaded_font_records
description: Walks the list of loaded font entries, copying each name and style fields into the next record of the caller's array and counting the records. When the second flag bit is set, it continues with a scan of the FONTS directory.

name: scan_font_directory_buffer
description: Copies characters from a read buffer into a name buffer, and when a name is complete records its entry in the caller's array. When the list ends it continues with the FONTS directory scan when the second flag bit is set.

name: scan_fonts_directory_files
description: Locks the FONTS directory and walks its entries with examine and next-entry calls. It records each entry whose name ends with the font suffix, and skips entries without that suffix.

name: read_font_file_entries
description: Reads a font file's header, checks that its first word matches the expected font file signature, then reads each font record, storing names and sizes in the output list and counting them.

name: read_font_file_entries_alternate
description: Reads a font file's header, checks that its first word matches the expected font file signature, then reads each font record, storing names and sizes in the output list and counting them.

name: finish_font_file_read
description: Reads the remaining font records from the file, closes it and releases its buffers. It returns a positive error value when the count of records read falls short, or zero when the read was complete.

name: release_font_scan_buffers
description: Frees the scan buffer and unlocks the directory, then returns a positive error value when the count went below zero, otherwise zero.

name: return_zero
description: Returns zero to the caller with no other work.

name: forward_to_library_handler
description: Calls another routine and returns without doing other work, so it acts as a forwarding entry point for the library.

name: forward_to_external_handler
description: Calls another routine through a function pointer and returns, with no other work. It is a forwarding stub for the library.

name: load_executable_hunk_table
description: Program entry code for the loader that allocates memory for each executable hunk, records the block addresses in a table, and checks each hunk against AmigaDOS hunk type codes.

name: return_without_work
description: Empty stub that returns to the caller without doing any work.

name: busy_wait_loop
description: Counts a register down to zero in a loop, using time without any other effect, and returns.

name: decode_back_reference_stream
description: Decodes a compressed data stream into a buffer, where a control value selects between repeating a byte and copying earlier output. It continues until the destination pointer reaches its limit.

name: decrement_loop_with_space_wrap
description: Decrements a byte held in a data register once for each step of a count, and replaces it with a space character when it wraps to zero. It makes no memory accesses.

name: stub_bad_instruction_data
description: Decoder artefact: the bytes at this address do not decode as valid code, so no behaviour can be recovered from them.

name: wait_startup_message_and_reply
description: Program entry code that finds its own task and, when the task has no process data, waits for a startup message on its port and takes it. If a message was received, it disables multitasking, replies to the message and returns zero.

name: wait_for_frames
description: Waits for the given number of display frames, calling the graphics library's vertical-blank wait once per frame.

name: run_main_program_setup
description: Main program routine that opens the diskfont, graphics and device resources, sets up the display and an interrupt server, shows a prompt telling the user to press 2 for two or SHIFT-Q to exit, and then runs its main loop.

name: poll_messages_and_shutdown
description: Repeatedly takes messages from the port and replies to them. When its countdown reaches minus one it runs a shutdown sequence of library calls that releases the program's resources.

name: reply_messages_and_run_shutdown
description: Replies to port messages as they arrive and runs the same polling loop, going on to a shutdown sequence of library calls when its countdown reaches minus one.

name: advance_sprite_history_and_blit
description: Clears three counters, shifts a set of stored values one slot back in a history buffer, copies memory, blits the bitmap, moves sprites and clears the raster. It repeats for each frame.

name: run_speed_adjusted_frame_loop
description: Clears a state value, lowers a speed counter by four with a floor of five, then runs the shared frame loop that calls the library for each frame.

name: advance_timers_and_redraw_frame
description: Computes a timer value from a stored count, updates two sequence counters and swaps stored state values when a condition holds, then redraws the frame through library calls.

name: draw_cell_grid_and_update
description: Draws a grid of cells by making pairs of library calls for each of three rows, then updates the display and the speed counters in the shared frame loop.

name: reset_counters_and_run_loop
description: Increments a counter, clears four state values and a sequence counter, cancels a pending request when one exists, then runs the shared frame loop.

name: enter_frame_loop_mode_one
description: Sets one state flag to one, then runs the shared frame loop that draws and updates the bitmaps each frame.

name: scale_speed_and_run_loop
description: When a step counter is below two, increments it and doubles a speed value, cancelling a pending request first if one exists. It then runs the shared frame loop.

name: enter_frame_loop_mode_two
description: Sets one state flag to one, then runs the shared frame loop that draws and updates the bitmaps each frame.

name: enter_frame_loop_mode_three
description: Sets one state flag to one, then runs the shared frame loop that draws and updates the bitmaps each frame.

name: enter_frame_loop_mode_four
description: Sets one state flag to one, then runs the shared frame loop that draws and updates the bitmaps each frame.

name: remap_cells_and_run_loop
description: Remaps each cell code in a region to one of a small set of values, then runs the shared frame loop.

name: write_cells_and_run_loop
description: Writes cell codes into a buffer, mapping each input value to one of a small set of codes, then runs the shared frame loop.

name: write_pattern_and_run_loop
description: Writes a repeating cell pattern into a buffer, calling a library routine for each entry, then runs the shared frame loop.

name: write_cell_pattern_and_blit
description: Writes a repeating cell pattern into a buffer and blits it through the graphics library, stepping through the buffer until its limit.

name: enter_frame_loop_mode_five
description: Sets two state flags to one, then runs the shared frame loop that draws and updates the bitmaps each frame.

name: cycle_four_step_value
description: Advances a four-step counter and selects the matching stored value for the next step, repeating while that value is zero, then runs the shared frame loop.

name: select_three_step_value
description: Selects one of three stored values from a counter that advances on each pass, then runs the shared frame loop.

name: select_two_step_value
description: Selects one of two or three stored values from a counter that advances on each pass, then runs the shared frame loop.

name: reset_step_value
description: Resets a step counter, selects the first stored value, steps through the remaining stored values while they are zero, then runs the shared frame loop.

name: call_twice_then_run_loop
description: Makes two calls to other routines, then runs the shared frame loop that draws and updates the bitmaps each frame.

name: halve_speed_and_run_loop
description: When a step counter is not minus one, decrements it and halves a speed value, cancelling a pending request first if one exists. It then runs the shared frame loop.

name: enter_frame_loop_reverse_mode
description: Sets a mode value to minus one, then runs the shared frame loop that draws and updates the bitmaps each frame.

name: release_devices_and_ports
description: Shuts down the devices, ports and interrupt server the program opened: aborts and waits on pending I/O, removes the interrupt server and port, closes the device, and frees the signal and memory before returning.

name: draw_title_text_and_blit
description: Draws a text string through the graphics library after setting the drawing mode and cursor position, then blits and clears the rasters around it.

name: drain_port_messages
description: Takes and replies to every pending port message until none remain, then returns.

name: wait_for_flagged_message
description: Waits for frame timing, then takes each port message, replies to it and records whether one of its flag bits is set, repeating until a flag is found.

name: update_bounce_timing_and_position
description: Counts down a timer and, when it expires, reloads it from a speed value. It flips a direction value when a position passes its low or high limit, then updates a second timer the same way.

name: call_graphics_routine_once
description: Calls one graphics library routine and returns, with no other work.

name: check_grid_cell_at_position
description: Converts a position into a grid cell index and reads the cell value there. An empty cell or a position off the grid returns the input unchanged, and a cell value of five updates stored positions and a counter.

name: clear_grid_cell_and_blit
description: Converts a position into a grid cell. When the cell holds a value below five it is cleared and written back, the blitter draws the result, and a counter is adjusted.

name: format_decimal_digits
description: Writes the digits of an unsigned number as decimal characters into a buffer, starting from the ten-thousands place and ending after the last digit, without a terminator.

name: write_decimal_digits_from_divisor
description: Writes the digits of an unsigned number as decimal characters into a buffer, using a divisor held in a register that starts at ten thousand and is reduced by ten on each step.

name: check_level_end_show_score
description: Draws a row of marks with the blitter, and when the computed value reaches the target it writes the score and board label text, then displays them and returns.

name: show_score_when_target_reached
description: Updates a counter from a stored value on each pass, and when that value reaches the target it writes the score and board label text and displays it.

name: blit_cell_if_occupied
description: Converts a position into a grid cell and blits that cell's image only when the cell holds a non-zero value.
